verdict.rationale: Helicone's Sessions feature groups related requests so an entire agent flow can be traced from initial input to final response in one view. It uses path-based hierarchy to organize steps by type, and the GitHub README highlights iterating on sessions and traces in the UI. A community user also credits it with debugging long LangChain chains and runaway agents. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of nested span/parent-child hierarchy depth, coverage of non-LLM steps (tool calls) as spans, and independent hands-on corroboration of session tracing specifically.
